name: Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.value: 10 years actually living in Slovenia, including the last 5 consecutive years
requirements.blocker_text: Citizenship Act of the Republic of Slovenia: applicants must be 18+, have actually lived in Slovenia for 10 years total including the last 5 years consecutively, have financial security and stable housing, pass a Slovenian-language interview before an expert commission, have no criminal conviction exceeding 1 year's imprisonment, be released from their previous citizenship (with exceptions for stateless persons), and have no residence ban.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 10 years of actual residence in Slovenia (5 of them consecutive, immediately before applying), meet the language/financial/conduct conditions, and apply.

requirement_groups.name: Slovenian emigrants and descendants (up to 3rd generation)

requirements.blocker_text: Slovenian emigrants, and their descendants up to the third generation in a direct line, may naturalize after just 1 year of residence, provided other general conditions are met -- a diaspora-oriented fast track.
requirements.fix_path: Document Slovenian emigrant ancestry (direct line, up to 3 generations), establish 1 year of residence, and apply.

requirement_groups.name: Special scientific, economic, or cultural significance

requirements.blocker_text: A person of special significance to Slovenia for scientific, economic, or cultural reasons may naturalize without meeting the standard requirements, upon approval by the Government (executive council).
requirements.fix_path: Document special scientific, economic, or cultural significance to Slovenia and obtain government approval.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 10 years' actual residence (5 consecutive)
Proof of financial security and stable housing
Proof of release from previous citizenship (or statelessness exception)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 10 years total (5 consecutive) standard; 1 year for emigrant descendants; none required for the special-merit track

sources.title: Uradni list Republike Slovenije (Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia) -- Zakon o drzavljanstvu Republike Slovenije (Citizenship Act), naturalization tracks

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovenia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirements sourced directly to Slovenia's own Official Gazette, tier 1. THE FULLER PICTURE on dual nationality (forward-referenced from si_citizenship_by_descent.json and si_citizenship_by_marriage.json): the Act states dual citizenship is permitted generally, and dual nationals residing in Slovenia are treated as Slovenian citizens domestically unless an international treaty says otherwise, with no renunciation mandated as a blanket rule -- but the STANDARD naturalization track (this file, 10-year route) separately lists 'release from previous citizenship' among its conditions (with an exception for stateless applicants). This is a real, disclosed internal tension rather than a contradiction resolved in this build: in practice this likely means the standard route expects renunciation unless the applicant's origin country refuses to release it or an exception applies, while other tracks (marriage, emigrant-descent) are described as exempt from this condition entirely. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE, MARQUEE FINDING: the emigrant/descendant-up-to-third-generation track (1 year) is a strong diaspora-oriented provision, comparable in spirit to North Macedonia's Article 8 track built earlier in this dataset. requirement value for the standard track is expressed as descriptive text (a combined total/consecutive-years condition) rather than a single number, since the rule genuinely has two parts that a single numeric threshold would misrepresent.
